message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# Codespell configuration is within pyproject.toml
---
name: Codespell

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  codespell:
    name: Check for spelling errors
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Annotate locations with typos
        uses: codespell-project/codespell-problem-matcher@v1
      - name: Codespell
        uses: codespell-project/actions-codespell@v2
        with:
          ignore_words_file: .codespellignore
          skip: "go.sum"",
  "rationale": "The workflow's single codespell job has no explicit timeout, so a hung or runaway run can consume unbounded runner time without changing any check coverage. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by measured experiment evidence showing successful runs preserved with elapsed-time savings when an explicit job timeout is added. Adding timeout-minutes: 5 is a minimal, scope-limited change that preserves all existing steps, triggers, permissions, and required-check behavior while bounding runaway consumption. Observed repository runs complete in seconds, so five minutes provides ample headroom for cold dependency installation by the codespell action.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8"]
}
